subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and changing it is a user-visible display contract rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Change agent-visible path output to full absolute paths by default and update helpers, prompts, docs, and tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Opt-In
options.body: Keep current defaults but add a documented setting for users who need absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the exact session-renderer display helper and documented the preserved shorthand behavior in the merged fix.
